verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Cactus runs on macOS Arm, but only as a supported platform with "no GPU". It never documents ARM-specific optimizations or Metal acceleration for inference. A community report adds that Needle 3 does not run inference on the Apple GPU, which is used only for training. Because the vendor never claims Metal acceleration, this is an absence of the capability rather than a dispute.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get accelerated inference on Apple Silicon via native ARM and Metal optimizations
